new op softcapped_attention needs a new primitive (Sec. Model Architecture, Logit soft-capping): Needs a GQA causal attention primitive that applies 50*tanh(s/50) to the [heads, T, T] pre-softmax logit matrix before the softmax. Its window must also switch between 4096-token sliding-window layers and global (8192) layers on alternating layers. The standard attention op exposes neither the logit cap nor a per-layer window schedule.; no family here builds it and no expr can state it, so the chain refuses rather than approximates (paper: “We cap logits~\citep{bello2016combinatorial} in each attention layer and the final layer such that the value of the logits stays between $-\text{soft\_cap}$ and $+\text{soft\_cap}$.”)

Model Architecture: “We alternate between a local sliding window attention~\citep{slidingwindow, beltagy2020longformer} and global attention~\citep{globalattention} in every other layer.”); no family here builds it, and training the extracted flavours alone would silently approximate the paper
